name: Valutazione del primo rilascio aziendale
description: Record real release findings and evidence. Defining or binding these checkpoints does not establish readiness or human acceptance.
prompts: Identify the qualified release criteria and exact supporting Sources. Record missing, stale or unverified evidence.
Assess governed inference: what Recall and W disclosed, required and omitted; exact target capacity; execution result or refusal. Cite retained evidence.
Assess restart, retry, authority and parallel Case isolation using qualified product observations. Record unresolved defects and limitations.
Human release decision: ready or not ready, with reasons, exact evidence references and remaining conditions. Automated qualification cannot supply human acceptance.
